report.markdown:
# Discovery of Penicillin

## Overview

One source reports that penicillin was discovered in 1928 by the Scottish physician Alexander Fleming. [1] It is also reported that Fleming was the first to experimentally demonstrate that a Penicillium mould secretes this antibacterial substance while working at St Mary's Hospital in London in 1928. [2]

## Sources

1. [Penicillin - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Penicillin) — wikipedia.org, published 2001-09-28, fetched 2026-10-31
2. [Discovery of penicillin - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Discovery_of_penicillin) — wikipedia.org, published 2009-09-13, fetched 2026-10-31
